summary.text: Ken King is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 88 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Heather Wallace is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ken King assumed office in the Texas House in 2013, according to Ballotpedia.
For 2023-2024 he chaired the Licensing & Administrative Procedures Committee and was assigned to the Public Education Committee.
In 2021-2022 he chaired the Culture, Recreation, & Tourism Committee.
